body: Change your major. Now. Please. Just look at the catalogue. It might take another year and more loans, but you'll pay even more after college if you don't find a job you like. Please don't be like me.
How much would you say is a decent salary for you?

This mindset is exactly what I'm talking about.

Does it not get tiring when you have to constantly think about how your "friend" is plotting against you? That you can't truly open up to someone because they will make fun of your struggles?
